steps: Go to the official promo page https://www.camdennational.bank/fall-bonus and open a new checking account (New England residents can apply online).
Fund the account with the $25 minimum opening deposit.
Within 60 days of opening, switch direct deposit(s) totaling $500 or more into the new checking account.
Optional: open your first new savings account and deposit $10,000 in new money within 20 days for an extra $200.
Keep both accounts open and in good standing; the promo page does not state payout timing.
To avoid monthly fees, meet the waiver conditions for the chosen account ($5 fee waived with $500 average daily balance on Rewards Checking).
